scenario: Every Monday, pull last week's Zendesk tickets, count first-response and resolution SLA breaches per priority and per agent group, and post a ranked breach summary to the #support-leads Slack channel.

On the first business day of the month, total all refunds issued through Stripe and logged on Freshdesk tickets, split by refund reason code, and append a row to the Finance 'Support Refunds' Google Sheet plus email the controller.

Each Friday, aggregate CSAT survey responses from Intercom conversations closed that week, compute average score and response count per agent, and post a leaderboard to Slack, flagging agents below the team floor.
rule_hooks: minimum CSAT threshold, minimum survey count

scenario: Before each quarterly business review, gather all helpdesk tickets for the enterprise accounts listed in Salesforce, count them by category and severity, and write a per-account summary into the account's QBR Google Doc.
Every morning, list Jira escalation tickets linked from Zendesk that are still open, bucket them by age (0-2, 3-7, 8+ days), and email engineering managers the counts and oldest items per component.
At 8 am, count open, pending and on-hold tickets per Freshdesk group, compare against yesterday's row in the Backlog Tracker sheet, and append today's row with day-over-day deltas.
Weekly, read RMA requests logged in the returns Google Sheet and linked Zendesk tickets, tally returns by product SKU and reason, and post the top five SKUs by return count to #product-quality.

At month end, count Stripe disputes opened that month, match them to support tickets by customer email, and report how many had a prior refund request in the helpdesk, emailing the totals to the payments lead.

Monthly, pull help center article view counts and the number of tickets that cited each article from Zendesk Guide, compute a deflection ratio, and publish the top and bottom ten articles to the Knowledge team Notion page.

Each quarter, list knowledge base articles not updated within the review window, count them per owner, and create a summary row per owner in the KB Audit Airtable base, then message each owner in Slack with their count.
Weekly, compute average handle time per agent from Gorgias ticket events, compare it with the team median, and send each team lead a list of agents more than the allowed percentage above median.

After each product release, count Zendesk tickets tagged with the new version number in the first 72 hours, group them by feature tag, and post the counts to the release's Slack thread and the release notes Confluence page.

Every Friday, sum goodwill credits issued to customers in QuickBooks with a support memo, compare against each team's monthly credit budget in Google Sheets, and post remaining budget per team to #support-ops.
Weekly, find HubSpot customers with three or more negative-sentiment or cancellation-tagged tickets in the past 30 days, rank them by ARR, and email the list to the customer success director.
Daily, pull call logs from Aircall, compute abandonment rate and average wait time per hour block, and append the results to the Phone Ops sheet, flagging hours above target in a Slack message.

At month end, count tickets by contact reason field across email, chat and phone channels in Freshdesk, compute each reason's share and change vs. last month, and update the Contact Reasons slide data in Google Sheets.

Weekly, count Zendesk tickets that were solved and then reopened within the reopen window, compute the reopen rate per agent and per category, and post the five worst categories to the quality channel.
Each morning, list tickets from customers marked VIP in Salesforce received in the last 24 hours, report first-response time for each, and email the support manager any that exceeded the VIP target.

Monthly, total approved warranty claims from the helpdesk with replacement part costs from the Xero bills, group by product line, and append the summary to the Warranty Costs sheet for the operations VP.
rule_hooks: warranty eligibility period, part cost list

scenario: Every two weeks, aggregate ticket QA review scores from the QA Google Sheet per agent and rubric section, compute averages, and post a summary to each team lead's Slack DM with agents below the passing score.

When an incident is closed in Statuspage, count tickets created during the incident window that mention the affected service, and add the count and peak hourly volume to the incident's postmortem Google Doc.

Weekly, compare ticket arrivals per hour from Intercom against scheduled agent shifts in Google Calendar, compute tickets per scheduled agent for each block, and post the most understaffed blocks to #workforce-planning.
rule_hooks: target tickets per agent per hour

scenario: Monthly, read cancellation request tickets in Help Scout and the cancellation reason recorded in Chargebee, tally reasons and saved vs. lost outcomes, and email the retention summary to the head of customer success.
rule_hooks: cancellation reason codes, save offer outcomes

scenario: Quarterly, group tickets submitted on behalf of reseller-managed accounts by reseller using the partner field in HubSpot, count volume and average resolution time, and send each partner manager their partner's figures.
Monthly, count how often each Zendesk macro was applied and how many tickets using it were reopened, and write a table to the Support Tooling Notion page flagging unused macros for retirement.

Weekly, count tickets escalated from Tier 1 to Tier 2 groups in Freshdesk, by escalation reason and originating agent, and append the totals to the Escalations tracker sheet with the escalation rate per agent.

At month end, collect billing-dispute tickets from Zendesk, match each to the disputed QuickBooks invoice, total disputed amount and amount credited, and email the AR manager the open disputed balance by customer.
rule_hooks: dispute status mapping, invoice match by number

scenario: Weekly, pull Intercom bot conversations, count those resolved without a human handoff vs. escalated, by bot workflow, and post the containment rates and lowest-performing workflows to #support-automation.

Monthly, count tickets per language using the helpdesk language field, compute average first-response time per language, and update the Localization Staffing sheet with a row per language for the support director.

Weekly, find accounts in Salesforce that went live within the last 60 days, count their support tickets by category, and post a list of new accounts with above-normal ticket counts to the onboarding team's Slack channel.
rule_hooks: onboarding period, normal ticket count benchmark

scenario: At quarter end, compute tickets solved and average CSAT per agent from Zendesk, apply the bonus eligibility criteria from the HR policy sheet, and write eligible agents and bonus tier into the Payroll Bonus sheet for HR.

Weekly, count lost, damaged and late-delivery tickets in Gorgias, grouped by carrier from the linked Shopify order, and email the logistics manager the per-carrier counts and the share of orders affected.
rule_hooks: shipping issue tags, carrier field on order

scenario: Monthly, count GDPR/CCPA data access and deletion request tickets, check each against the legal response deadline, and append the counts of on-time, late and open requests to the Privacy Compliance sheet for the DPO.
Every two weeks, tally tickets tagged as feature requests by requested feature, weight each by the requester's plan tier from HubSpot, and post the ranked top ten to the product team's Slack channel.

Weekly, list low CSAT responses from the survey tool with their Zendesk tickets, count how many received a manager follow-up within the policy window, and email the support VP the follow-up completion rate by team.

Monthly, count on-site service visits booked from support tickets in the scheduling calendar, total technician hours and dispatch costs from the visit log sheet, and post a summary by region to the field service channel.

At month end, compute each enterprise customer's support SLA attainment from helpdesk data, compare it with the contracted SLA in DocuSign-signed terms recorded in Salesforce, and add a row per breaching account with the owed service credit to the SLA Credits sheet.
rule_hooks: contracted SLA levels, service credit schedule

scenario: Daily, count support-related social mentions routed into Freshdesk from Twitter and Facebook, by sentiment and response status, and append the day's totals to the Social Care sheet with any unanswered complaints listed in Slack.

Monthly, combine QA failure reasons and escalation categories per agent from the QA sheet and Zendesk, rank the top gap areas per team, and post the recommended training topics to the enablement team's Asana project as a summary task.

Ahead of the quarterly board meeting, gather ticket volume, median resolution time, CSAT, NPS and cost per ticket from the helpdesk, survey tool and Xero support expense accounts, and fill the Support KPI section of the board pack Google Doc with quarter-over-quarter changes.
rule_hooks: KPI definitions, support cost GL accounts

scenario: Every Monday, pull last week's tickets from Zendesk, compute median and 90th-percentile first-response time per channel (email, chat, web form, phone callback), and post a comparison table against each channel's target to the #support-leads Slack channel.

At month end, read all refunds issued from Stripe and match them to Freshdesk tickets, flag refunds above an agent's approval limit that lack a manager-approval tag, and write the count and dollar total per agent to an audit tab in Google Sheets.
rule_hooks: refund approval limits by agent role

scenario: Each Friday, scan the week's solved Zendesk tickets for missing or invalid category/product tags, tally the gaps per agent and team, and email each team lead a short summary with their team's untagged percentage.
rule_hooks: required tag taxonomy, allowed tag list

scenario: Thirty days before a contract renewal date in Salesforce, gather the account's last 90 days of support tickets, open escalations, and CSAT, and post a health summary to the account's Slack channel for the account manager.
rule_hooks: renewal date window, health scoring thresholds

scenario: After the holiday peak period ends, compare daily ticket volume against the forecast in a planning spreadsheet, compute variance and overtime hours from the scheduling sheet, and publish a recap doc in Google Docs for the support director.
rule_hooks: forecast baseline, peak period dates, overtime rules

scenario: Every morning, list Freshdesk tickets in 'Pending customer' status grouped by days waiting, count those past the auto-close threshold, and post the buckets plus the count to be auto-closed today to Slack.

Weekly, total the loyalty points granted as compensation in support tickets (from a custom field in Gorgias), group them by reason code, and append a row with totals per reason to the marketing team's loyalty ledger sheet.

When a weekly export lands in Google Drive, count support tickets mentioning each manufacturing lot number, rank lots by defect complaints per units shipped, and send the top five to the quality team by email.
rule_hooks: lot shipment quantities, defect rate alert threshold

scenario: Monthly, compare each Zendesk organization's SLA policy against the support plan recorded on the HubSpot company record, count mismatched accounts by plan tier, and post the list to the support ops channel.

Daily, read Aircall callback tasks and their linked tickets, compute the share of promised callbacks completed within the promised window per agent, and update a row per agent in the team performance sheet.

At quarter end, combine ticket counts per account from Intercom with segment and ARR from Salesforce and a loaded agent cost-per-hour figure, compute support cost per segment as a percentage of ARR, and write the result to the finance planning doc.

Weekly, read resolved return requests in Loop Returns and Shopify, compute the ratio of exchanges to refunds by product category, and post it to Slack with categories below the target exchange rate highlighted.

Every Tuesday, pull Zendesk tickets linked to Jira issues, compute how long each Jira issue has been open versus the engineering response SLA for its priority, and email the breaching list with counts per engineering team to the engineering manager.
rule_hooks: engineering SLA by priority, team ownership map

scenario: Each week, for agents hired in the last 60 days (from the BambooHR roster), compute tickets solved, CSAT, and reopen rate, compare them to the ramp-plan milestones in a sheet, and send each new hire's manager a summary.
rule_hooks: ramp milestones by week of tenure

scenario: Monthly, count tickets merged as duplicates in Freshdesk per requester and per channel, identify customers who opened three or more duplicates, and post a summary to the support ops channel for contact-form improvements.

Weekly, bucket incoming tickets by arrival hour and timezone, count those arriving outside staffed hours by region, and append the totals to the coverage-planning sheet with a note to the workforce manager in Slack.
rule_hooks: staffed hours per region, holiday calendar

scenario: Every two weeks, collect tickets tagged 'price match' or 'price adjustment' from Gorgias, total the amounts granted versus denied according to the price-protection policy window, and email the summary to the pricing manager.

Monthly, compute the CSAT survey send count, response count, and response rate per channel and per brand from Zendesk satisfaction data, and update the CX dashboard sheet, flagging brands below the minimum sample size.
rule_hooks: minimum sample size for valid CSAT

scenario: At month end, list all customer credit memos created in QuickBooks with a support ticket reference, total outstanding unused credit per customer, and send the finance controller a report of credits older than the expiry period.

Weekly, compare the initial priority set on Jira Service Management tickets with the final priority at resolution, count upgrades and downgrades per intake channel, and post the matrix to the triage team channel.
Monthly, count how often agents put tickets 'on hold' (pausing the SLA clock) and the total paused hours per agent, flag agents above the allowed pause ratio, and email the list to the QA lead.
rule_hooks: allowed on-hold ratio, valid hold reasons

scenario: After each monthly CES survey closes in SurveyMonkey, join responses to the related ticket's contact reason, average effort score per customer journey stage, and publish a ranked table in a Notion page for the CX team.
rule_hooks: journey stage mapping from contact reasons

scenario: Weekly, find solved tickets that needed more than the target number of agent replies, group them by category and product, and send the top categories with example ticket links to the knowledge team in Slack.
Every Monday, read tickets tagged 'damaged on arrival' with order data from Shopify, total replacement cost by warehouse of origin, and email each warehouse manager their count and cost for the week.
rule_hooks: warehouse assignment by SKU, replacement cost table

scenario: Monthly, match Intercom conversations from trial users to HubSpot deal outcomes, compute conversion rate for trial users who contacted support versus those who didn't, and post the comparison to the sales-support sync channel.

Daily at shift end, combine logged-in time from the Talkdesk status report with handled ticket and call time, compute occupancy per agent, and update the workforce sheet, flagging agents above burnout or below idle thresholds.

Monthly, collect tickets classified as formal complaints under the financial-services complaint rules, count them by category and resolution status within the regulatory deadline, and append the totals to the compliance register sheet for the compliance officer.
rule_hooks: regulatory complaint definition, response deadline days

scenario: Monthly, read the breach-reason field agents fill on breached Zendesk tickets, total breaches by root cause (staffing, waiting on third party, misrouting), and write a pie-chart-ready summary to the ops review Google Slides deck notes.

Weekly, read retention-desk tickets where customers requested downgrades or cancellations, count saves, offers accepted, and losses by offer type from Chargebee, and post the save rate per offer to the retention channel.

Weekly, export help-center search terms that returned no results from Zendesk Guide, rank them by frequency, match against tickets opened within the same session, and send the top terms to the knowledge manager.

When the outsourced support vendor's monthly invoice arrives in Gmail, count the tickets and hours handled by vendor agents in Freshdesk, compare them against the billed quantities and contract rates, and post the variance to the finance channel.
rule_hooks: vendor contract rates, billable ticket definition

scenario: Weekly, read the sentiment score from Intercom conversation tags per product line, compute week-over-week change, and post product lines with a drop larger than the alert threshold to the product leadership channel.

Monthly, count tickets per customer over the last 30 days, list customers above the high-contact threshold along with their account owner from Salesforce, and email each account owner their outlier customers.
Quarterly, split CSAT results by resolution type (refund, replacement, workaround, no action), compute average score and count per type, and add the table to the quarterly CX review doc.

Weekly, gather tickets tagged account takeover, phishing, or suspicious login, count them by type and by whether they were escalated to the security team within the required hour, and post the summary to the security liaison channel.
Monthly, total refund requests per customer and per shipping address across Gorgias and Shopify, list those exceeding the serial-refunder limit, and send the report to the loss-prevention team.
Weekly, read Calendly onboarding and support-session bookings with their Zoom attendance, count no-shows per session type and customer segment, and post the rate to the onboarding team channel.

Monthly, compare tickets requiring each skill (language, product certification) routed via skills-based routing against the number of agents holding that skill in the skills matrix sheet, and send the gap ratios to the hiring manager.

Monthly, count support tickets where a DocuSign-signed settlement or release was required for refunds above a threshold, report how many were signed, pending, or expired, and update the legal tracker sheet.
Weekly, pull new Trustpilot and app-store reviews logged as tickets, count responded versus unresponded by star rating, compute average response time, and post the summary to the brand team channel.
rule_hooks: review response time target by star rating
